title: NFIB Guardian of Small Business Award
text:
NFIB’s prestigious Guardian of Small Business Award is reserved for legislators who vote consistently with small business on the key issues identified by small business owners. Those who voted with small business on key issues 70% or more of the time during the 118th Congress earned the NFIB Guardian of Small Business Award.
NFIB informs lawmakers in advance which votes will be considered NFIB Key Votes, asks lawmakers to support the consensus views of our members, and reminds legislators that their votes will be reported back to the NFIB membership.
Learn more about NFIB’s one member, one vote balloting, which guides NFIB priorities and key issues.
